verdict.rationale: Spline documents AI features that generate content: an AI Agent that builds and edits scenes, AI textures, and AI 3D generation. It also offers an OpenAI API integration for building AI text into published experiences. None of these is documented as analyzing the user's own data or files to surface insights or suggestions inside the product. Generation and developer integrations are adjacent capabilities, not this one, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
